title: bidens dissecta
intro: Bidens dissecta, commonly known as cutleaf beggar ticks, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Bidens dissecta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including eczema, acne, and skin infections, due to its ability to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation.
